## ACOSOG ZZ9001

GIST Tumors \>3cm randomized:

- 1 year of imatinib 40mg
- Observation

Recurrence-free survival 98% vs 83%

No significant difference at 6 years

*Imatinib may simply delay recurrences*

::: aside
Ref
:::

## Scandinavian Sarcoma Group XVIII

High-risk GIST randomized:

- 1 year of imatinib 400mg
- 3 year of imatinib 400mg

5-year Recurrence-free survival 48% vs 66%

5-year Overall Survival 82% vs 92%

::: aside
[@joensuu1265]
:::

## Persist-5 Trial

Single-arm study to evalute tolerance of 5 years of imatinib

- Tumors \>2cm with \>5 mitoses/hpf OR
- non-gastric primary

- 51% of patients discontinued therapy at some point
- 7/91 patients recurred
  - 1 during imatinib therapy
  - 6 within 2 years of discontinuation of imatinib

::: aside
[@Raute184060]
:::

## Positive Margins

908 gastric GIST 

R1 resection 162 (18%)

  - Rupture in 97/162 (60%)
  
There was a significant difference in OS for patients undergoing an R1 vs R0 resection, overall (hazard ratio [HR], 2.05; 95% CI, 1.45-2.89) and by treatment arm (HR, 2.65; 95% CI, 1.37-3.75 with adjuvant imatinib and HR, 1.86; 95% CI, 1.16-2.99 without adjuvant imatinib). When tumor rupture was excluded, this difference in OS between R1 and R0 resections disappeared (HR, 1.05; 95% CI, 0.54-2.01).

::: aside
[@gronchie200397]
:::

## Wild-Type GIST

KIT/PDGFRA-negative GIST should be tested for:

- SDH deficiency (detected by loss of SDHB expression on IHC)
- Next Generation Sequencing to look for alternative driver mutations


## Wild-Type GIST 

- SDH-Deficient
  - SDHx mutation
  - SDH wild-type
  - Associated with Carney-Stratakis syndrome
  
- Wild-type SDH
  - NF1-GIST
  - Sporadic Wild-Type GIST

::: aside
Weldon JCS 2017
:::

The following lecture is designed for a surgical resident audience, structured as a teaching handout covering the molecular biology of the succinate dehydrogenase (SDH) complex, the paraganglioma–pheochromocytoma (PPGL) syndromes (PGL1–5), SDH-deficient GIST, perioperative surgical management, and lifelong surveillance of carriers. [1-7] Key surgical teaching points are emphasized throughout — mandatory germline testing of all PPGL patients, preoperative alpha-blockade and biochemical screening before any operation, total (not cortical-sparing) adrenalectomy for SDHB pheochromocytoma, and the distinct biology and imatinib-resistance of SDH-deficient GIST. [1][3-6][8]
